<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_CarService" targetNamespace="https://example.com/bpmn/car-service">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Notification" name="Service reminder"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ServicePresented" name="Car presented for service"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ServiceAttended" name="Service attended"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_StatusEmail" name="Service status updates"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Payment" name="Payment through the app"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_CarService">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_PoliceSystem" name="Police app" processRef="Process_PoliceSystem"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_CarOwner" name="Car owner"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_ServiceFacility" name="Car service facility" processRef="Process_ServiceFacility"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_NotifyOwner" name="Service reminder" sourceRef="Task_NotifyOwner" targetRef="Participant_CarOwner" messageRef="Message_Notification"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_PresentCar" name="Car presented for service" sourceRef="Participant_CarOwner" targetRef="Start_ServicePresented" messageRef="Message_ServicePresented"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ServiceAttended" name="Service attended" sourceRef="Task_EnterProblems" targetRef="Catch_ServiceAttended" messageRef="Message_ServiceAttended"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_StatusEmail" name="Service status updates by email" sourceRef="Task_SendStatusUpdates" targetRef="Participant_CarOwner" messageRef="Message_StatusEmail"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Payment" name="Payment through the app" sourceRef="Participant_CarOwner" targetRef="Task_ReceivePayment" messageRef="Message_Payment"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_PoliceSystem" name="Car service reminders" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_SuccessfulService" name="Successful service"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_ServiceNecessary" name="Service becomes necessary"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckRegistration" name="Check whether the car is registered"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Registered" name="Car registered?"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_NotifyOwner" name="Notify the car owner">
      <bpmn:ioSpecification>
        <bpmn:dataInput id="DataInput_Notification" name="Service reminder" itemSubjectRef="Message_Notification"/>
        <bpmn:inputSet>
          <bpmn:dataInputRefs>DataInput_Notification</bpmn:dataInputRefs>
        </bpmn:inputSet>
        <bpmn:outputSet/>
      </bpmn:ioSpecification>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="Gateway_ServiceOrFine" name="Wait for service or 30 days"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_ServiceAttended" name="Service attended">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_ServiceAttended" messageRef="Message_ServiceAttended"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_30Days" name="30 days pass">
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="TimerEventDefinition_30Days">
        <bpmn:timeDuration xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">P30D</bpmn:timeDuration>
      </bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_IssueFine" name="Issue a fine"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Fined" name="Fine issued"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_ServiceAttended" name="Service attended"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_NotRegistered" name="Car not registered"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_System_1" sourceRef="Start_SuccessfulService" targetRef="Catch_ServiceNecessary"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_System_2" sourceRef="Catch_ServiceNecessary" targetRef="Task_CheckRegistration"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_System_3" sourceRef="Task_CheckRegistration" targetRef="Gateway_Registered"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_System_4" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_Registered" targetRef="Task_NotifyOwner">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${registered}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_System_5" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_Registered" targetRef="End_NotRegistered">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${not registered}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_System_6" sourceRef="Task_NotifyOwner" targetRef="Gateway_ServiceOrFine"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_System_7" sourceRef="Gateway_ServiceOrFine" targetRef="Catch_ServiceAttended"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_System_8" sourceRef="Gateway_ServiceOrFine" targetRef="Catch_30Days"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_System_9" sourceRef="Catch_ServiceAttended" targetRef="End_ServiceAttended"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_System_10" sourceRef="Catch_30Days" targetRef="Task_IssueFine"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_System_11" sourceRef="Task_IssueFine" targetRef="End_Fined"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_ServiceFacility" name="Car service" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_ServicePresented" name="Car presented for service">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_ServicePresented" messageRef="Message_ServicePresented"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EnterProblems" name="Enter car problems for reference"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_RepairAndUpdates" name="Repair and status updates"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RepairCar" name="Repair the car"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendStatusUpdates" name="Send status updates by email">
      <bpmn:ioSpecification>
        <bpmn:dataInput id="DataInput_StatusEmail" name="Service status updates" itemSubjectRef="Message_StatusEmail"/>
        <bpmn:inputSet>
          <bpmn:dataInputRefs>DataInput_StatusEmail</bpmn:dataInputRefs>
        </bpmn:inputSet>
        <bpmn:outputSet/>
      </bpmn:ioSpecification>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_RepairAndUpdatesJoin" name="Repair and updates complete"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceivePayment" name="Receive payment through the app" messageRef="Message_Payment"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EnterSuccessAndPickerl" name="Enter repair success and Pickerl"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EnterNextService" name="Enter the time for the next service"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_ServiceComplete" name="Service complete"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Facility_1" sourceRef="Start_ServicePresented" targetRef="Task_EnterProblems"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Facility_2" sourceRef="Task_EnterProblems" targetRef="Gateway_RepairAndUpdates"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Facility_3" sourceRef="Gateway_RepairAndUpdates" targetRef="Task_RepairCar"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Facility_4" sourceRef="Gateway_RepairAndUpdates" targetRef="Task_SendStatusUpdates"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Facility_5" sourceRef="Task_RepairCar" targetRef="Gateway_RepairAndUpdatesJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Facility_6" sourceRef="Task_SendStatusUpdates" targetRef="Gateway_RepairAndUpdatesJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Facility_7" sourceRef="Gateway_RepairAndUpdatesJoin" targetRef="Task_ReceivePayment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Facility_8" sourceRef="Task_ReceivePayment" targetRef="Task_EnterSuccessAndPickerl"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Facility_9" sourceRef="Task_EnterSuccessAndPickerl" targetRef="Task_EnterNextService"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Facility_10" sourceRef="Task_EnterNextService" targetRef="End_ServiceComplete"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
